provenance: Real OSM road geometry; hypothetical uncalibrated traffic, signal timing, and ambulance missions. Frozen v9 controller classes reused with allowed-turn route adaptation.

scenario_config.goal: Fortis Hospital mapped road approach; not emergency department doorway
scenario_config.speed_assumption: 50km/h upper cap on all imported lanes, retaining any lower modeled speed; not surveyed speeds
scenario_config.demand_design: After preserving an overloaded pilot and a zero-demand physical check, scale synthetic Poisson arrivals to nominal max X=0.85 using fixed ordinary-route pool and modeled green/service capacities; not field calibration or performance tuning.
scenario_config.geometry_correction: Six physical clockwise circulating arcs around the Fortis-area roundabout, imagery-digitized because the rawOSMsourcecutthroughtheisland; see geo/roundabout_patch/patch_provenance.json. No trajectorywarping.
